zh.title: 项目与开源贡献
zh.subtitle: Agent 工程 · 可恢复执行 · 工具可靠性
zh.project_intro: 面向软件维护长任务中的中断、重复请求与验收失真，开发带持久化状态、资源边界及证据归档的维护运行器。
bullets: 连接 SQLite 检查点与隔离 Git worktree；本机 ext4 上正常运行与首检查点 SIGKILL 恢复生成相同参考补丁，创建状态及复用成功前拒绝 NFS。
实现有界源码定位、原版测试验收与补丁/日志哈希校验；拒绝篡改缓存，修复独立会话和双重 fork 验证子进程泄漏，Linux 回收后代后释放运行锁。
持久预留 HTTP 次数和 JSON 字节，跨重启与修复共享；独立 asyncio/HTTPX2 包接入 Pydantic AI，4 场假服务控制覆盖工具、取消、并发及 SDK 重试。
实际接入 LlamaIndex 审计 8 份报告，核验 JSON 事实、来源哈希与读取记录；2 场假回复控制通过。完整124项回归通过、零跳过，含新增8项证据检查。
zh.project_scope: 恢复使用参考计划，未证明自主修复。真实9B CPU报告审计在600秒上限超时，零验收完成；旧ADK CPU无编辑，GPU短请求原样文本检查失败，GPU维护未启动。历史NFS结果分列，额度不是token或费用。

contributions.name: OpenHands SDK
contributions.text: 保留撤销失败后的历史；拒绝同路径补丁移动造成的文件丢失。真实权限/路径别名前后对照，相关185项/203项分别通过，不相加。

contributions.name: Google ADK
contributions.text: 修复产物并发删除中的文件消失竞态；Python 3.11 / 3.13 各 2021 项相关测试通过、26 项预期失败，保留嵌套产物。

contributions.name: Semantic Kernel
contributions.text: 修复实验性 Python 运行时取消回调重入死锁；103 项关联检查通过，真实请求取消后正常关闭。广泛套件仍有 12 项原版已有失败。

zh.paper_text: 第一作者 · IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters, vol. 22, 2025。研究前视声纳图像的轻量化目标检测。
zh.scope: 2026-11-21核验：4份开放草稿，均未合并；重叠测试不累加。Codex辅助实现与验证，人工复核和上游评审待完成。

en.title: Projects and contributions
en.subtitle: Agent engineering / Recoverable execution / Tool reliability
en.project_intro: A software-maintenance runner with durable state, resource limits and reviewable evidence for interrupted tasks, repeated requests and unreliable acceptance.
bullets: Connect SQLite checkpoints and isolated Git worktrees. Local ext4 normal and first-checkpoint SIGKILL runs produce the same reference patch; reject NFS before state creation or cached success.

Add bounded source navigation, frozen original-test acceptance and patch/log hash checks. Reject tampered caches; reap detached and double-forked Linux verifier descendants before releasing the worker lock.

Reserve HTTP attempts and JSON bytes across restarts and repair rounds. A standalone asyncio/HTTPX2 wheel integrates with Pydantic AI; four fake-service cases cover tools, cancellation, concurrency and SDK retries.

Integrate LlamaIndex with eight real reports to check JSON facts, source hashes and observed reads; two fake-reply controls pass. All 124 engineering checks pass with zero skips, including eight new evidence checks.
en.project_scope: Recovery uses reference plans, not autonomous repair. The real 9B CPU report audit times out at 600 seconds with no verified assessment; earlier ADK CPU makes no edits. GPU raw text fails and maintenance never starts. Historical NFS evidence is separate; quotas are not tokens or fees.

contributions.name: OpenHands SDK
contributions.text: Preserve history after failed undo; reject same-path patch moves that delete files. Real permission/alias reproductions; 185 and 203 related checks pass separately.

contributions.name: Google ADK
contributions.text: Handle files disappearing during concurrent artifact deletion, retaining nested artifacts. Python 3.11/3.13 each pass the same 2,021 related tests with 26 expected failures.

contributions.name: Semantic Kernel
contributions.text: Release the experimental Python token lock before callbacks. 103 related checks pass and runtime cancellation completes; 12 existing broader failures remain.

en.paper_text: First author. IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters, vol. 22, 2025. Lightweight object detection in forward-looking sonar imagery.
en.scope: Checked 2026-11-21: four open drafts, none merged; overlapping tests are not added. Codex assisted implementation and verification; human author and upstream review remain pending.
